facts.text: In July the notch between the false and true summits can still hold snow, with a small moat on the far side of the snow lip.
The notch below the summit tower can be rappelled or downclimbed; the downclimb has one or two awkward moves, so a rappel suits a mixed party.
In July a picket set in the tall snow berm beside the summit wall protects the leader before the first rock moves.

notes: The two Austera routes appear to describe the same standard line (Eldorado trailhead, Inspiration/McAllister/Klawatti glaciers, summit tower), so the owner may want to merge them; the track went to the Southwest Ridge entry only. Parent route text puts the 75 ft rappel into the Klawatti Glacier, which no in-season report distinguished. No web search was run for season; it relies on stored guidebook-derived text and the ascent histogram.
